title: Quality Studio performance
summary: Tracks measured startup, repository switching, tree transport, review-run latency, rendering, and long-session memory. QS-82 implements lazy tree transport on QS-54/QS-78 cache and snapshot work; its measured gains were independently reproduced, reconciled with QS-86, and final-gated on 2026-09-01 after replaying approved tip 564922a5 onto origin/main 367aeff. The Release build, 237 .NET tests, 58 Angular tests, security/dependency checks, and 13-point tree-v2 contract all pass.
